notes: Board of Park Commissioners minutes, 1942. Curated; dated by the page footers (m/d/yy) and the meeting openers.

coverage.remaining: War-years repair contracts, wartime uses of parks, and works with no page (Sutro Heights diorama house, the Golden Gate Park orchid house, Bufano statues at Aquatic Park) not placed.

findings.address_as_written: Victory House and stage, Union Square
findings.description: The Board of Park Commissioners approved a plan for a Victory House in Union Square, given by the Standard Oil Company, with a stage designed by Timothy Pflueger to be built by the Treasury Department, for selling war bonds and stamps.

citation.label: Minutes of the Board of Park Commissioners, October 8, 1942

raw.text: Victory House and stage, Union Square

resolution.method: A named park, playground or park building placed on its Recreation and Park place page by the name and streets the minutes give.

findings.address_as_written: demolition of certain buildings within the Tea Garden
findings.description: Buildings in the Japanese Tea Garden were being demolished; the Board of Park Commissioners said only those in poor condition and infested with termites would go, and that the garden was being restored to a set plan.

citation.label: Minutes of the Board of Park Commissioners, November 12, 1942
